# SupportFlow

> SupportFlow is an app for independent NDIS support workers in Australia. It keeps shifts, progress notes, kilometres, expenses, invoices and a running tax estimate in one private app that works offline once loaded.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://supportflow.work/): what SupportFlow does and how to get started
- [Pricing](https://supportflow.work/pricing.html): A$49 one-time Lifetime licence, with a free trial of 5 invoices
- [Invoice template](https://supportflow.work/ndis-support-worker-invoice-template): NDIS invoice template for support workers
- [Progress notes template](https://supportflow.work/ndis-support-worker-progress-notes): NDIS progress notes template
- [Privacy policy](https://supportflow.work/privacy): how data is handled
- [Terms of use](https://supportflow.work/terms): terms of use

## The app

- [Open SupportFlow](https://supportflow.work/app): the app runs in the browser
